title: More B1: …时, 那么, 用 / 通过…来, 在…上, 使 / 请, 经过, 我来
description: When (formal), in that case, by means of, in terms of, causing / inviting, after / passing by, and 'let me'.

points.title: …时: when (formal)
points.summary: Clause + 时 = …的时候, a bit more written.
points.body:
- 上课**时**，请关手机.
- 我到家**时**，他已经睡了.
examples: Please switch off your phone during class.

points.title: 那么: in that case, then
points.summary: 那么 (nàme) at the start = 'well then, in that case'.
points.body: - A: 我今天很忙. B: **那么**，我们明天再见吧.

points.title: 用 / 通过 + method + 来 + verb
points.summary: 来 links the method and the goal: 用这个方法来解决问题.
examples: {我们|wǒmen}{可以|kěyǐ}{用|yòng}{这个|zhège}{方法|fāngfǎ}{来|lái}{解决|jiějué}{问题|wèntí}。
We can use this method to solve the problem.

points.title: 在 + topic + 上: in terms of
points.summary: 在学习上 (in studying), 在这个问题上 (on this issue).
examples: On this issue I agree with you.

points.title: 使 / 请 + person + verb
points.summary: 使 (shǐ) = cause, make (feelings, written). 请 (qǐng) = invite / treat (请你吃饭 = my treat).
points.body:
- 这个消息**使**大家都很高兴.
- 今天我**请**你吃饭.

points.title: 经过: after (a process); pass by
points.summary: 经过 (jīngguò) + effort / time = after; 经过 + place = pass by.
points.body:
- **经过**三年的努力，他终于成功了.
- 我每天上班都**经过**这个公园.
examples: {经过|jīngguò}{三|sān}{年|nián}{的|de}{努力|nǔlì}，{他|tā}{终于|zhōngyú}{成功|chénggōng}{了|le}。
After three years of hard work, he finally succeeded.

points.title: 我来 (+ verb): let me
points.summary: 来 can stand in for a verb: 我来吧 = let me (do it).
points.body:
- 这个箱子太重了。——我**来**吧!
- 你休息，我**来**做饭.
examples: You rest, I'll do the cooking.

notes: 时间 is a noun — 上课时间 would need another verb.
后来 can't follow a verb.
questions.translation: Please switch off your phone during class.
When I got home, he was already asleep.

questions.prompt:
A：{我|wǒ}{今天|jīntiān}{很|hěn}{忙|máng}。
B：（　），{我们|wǒmen}{明天|míngtiān}{再|zài}{见|jiàn}{吧|ba}。
questions.translation: A: I'm busy today. B: Well then, let's meet tomorrow.

questions.prompt: Which one means 'In that case, let's not go'?
notes: 这么 doesn't start a conclusion.

questions.prompt: {我们|wǒmen}{可以|kěyǐ}{用|yòng}{这个|zhège}{方法|fāngfǎ}（　）{解决|jiějué}{问题|wèntí}。
notes: 去 isn't the linking verb here.
questions.translation: We can use this method to solve the problem.

notes: 通过 comes before the method.
来 links the method and the goal.

questions.prompt: {在|zài}{学习|xuéxí}（　），{他|tā}{很|hěn}{努力|nǔlì}，{可是|kěshì}{在|zài}{生活|shēnghuó}{上|shang}{有点儿|yǒudiǎnr}{懒|lǎn}。
notes: 在学习下 isn't the pattern.
questions.translation: When it comes to studying he works hard, but in daily life he's a bit lazy.

questions.prompt: What does 「{在|zài}{这个|zhège}{问题|wèntí}{上|shang}，{我|wǒ}{同意|tóngyì}{你|nǐ}。」 mean?

notes: 把大家都很高兴 isn't grammatical (no action verb).
被 = passive — the news didn't suffer.
对大家都很高兴 isn't grammatical.
questions.translation: This good news made everyone very happy.
Dinner's on me today — what would you like?
After three years of hard work, he finally succeeded.

notes: 过去 = 'go over / the past' — doesn't take the park as object here.
questions.translation: I pass this park on my way to work every day.
A: This box is too heavy. B: Let me!

questions.prompt: What does 「{你|nǐ}{休息|xiūxi}，{我|wǒ}{来|lái}{做饭|zuòfàn}。」 mean?
notes: It's about now, not the past.
来 here doesn't mean physically coming.
